page.layout: One column of running text; running head above it; page number at the top right; gathering signature at the foot left; no marginal notes.

main_text.p: definētib.inferiores succedere, generaliter locuta est, siue per mortem, siue per emancipationem, siue per deportationem, siue per captiuitatem sui es-se desinant, ac de familia demigrent. Non pertinent autem ad illam, quia u-trunq; caput legis ad eos pertinet, qui uiuo teftatore nati sunt: non autem ad posthumos. Cur autē hoc Sceuola in re adeo perspicua nos admoneret, causa erat fortasse non necessaria: nisi forte uerum illud fit, quod in primo de Oratore Cicero scribit, uerbi controuer-sia torqueri Græculos homines, con-tentionis cupidiores quàm ueritatis.

Ex sententia legis Velleæ.) Id est, ex præ-scripto legis. Tametsi, inquit, non ex Aquiliana formulæ scripto ac verbis, tamen ex beneficio legis Velleæ: quæ his omnibus casibus sui ius adeptos rumpere prohibet.
Quare non induxere.) Fortasse, INDU-XERAT. nam ad legem Velleam pertinere hoc non potest, sed ad Gallum duntaxat.
Anteaquam filius.) Ordo est, Si filius de cederet, antequam ab hostibus redi-ret,

page.notes: Long s read as f throughout and transcribed as s (e.g. "fuccedere", "ef-fe", "teftatore"). u/v spelling corrected per rule 5 (e.g. "uiuo" to "viuo", "INDV" to "INDU"). Running head "GALLVS" corrected to "GALLUS". "de cederet" is printed with a visible gap and may be one word. "definētib." is uncertain. The lead-in "Velleæ" may print as "Vellea". The final word "ret," is the continuation of "redi-" at the foot of the page. The signature "O 2" is read from a faint mark and may be partly obscured.
